composer.title: Quick Mission Composer
composer.desc_build_review: 1 agent builds the task; when finished, a 2nd agent automatically reviews the result read-only.
composer.desc_fanout: Split subtasks across parallel worker agents (1 line = 1 worker) under one coordinating Captain.
composer.desc_compare: Run the same task side-by-side on 2 different harnesses or models to compare their solutions.
composer.desc_captain: Launch a standalone coordinator Captain thread with its own mission and shared crew rules.
composer.placeholder_build_review: Describe what to build or fix (e.g. Implement OAuth login flow and verify tests)…

composer.placeholder_captain: Describe this Captain's ongoing mission or coordination instructions…

workflows.heading: Cross-Harness Workflows
workflows.intro: Combine any harnesses and models in Zeron without harness lock-in. Captain Deck spawns each stage, tracks live turns, and handles automatic handoffs.
workflows.preset_build_review_desc: One harness builds the task; when it finishes, a different harness automatically reviews the result read-only.
workflows.preset_fanout_desc: Spin up parallel workers across subtasks (one per line) on any harness and report back to one Captain.
workflows.preset_compare_desc: Run the same prompt side-by-side on two different harnesses or models under one Captain to compare outputs.
